title: Receptacle Branch Circuit Survey
description: Survey a 120 V receptacle: hot-neutral, hot-ground, and neutral-ground voltages to confirm correct wiring and low neutral-ground offset.

steps.title: Safety And Setup
steps.instruction: SAFETY: Use a CAT III/IV rated meter and inspect leads. Insert probes fully and keep fingers behind the barriers. Do not bridge slots with bare fingers. This survey is for standard 120 V NEMA 5-15/5-20 receptacles.

steps.title: Measure Hot-Neutral
steps.instruction: Set the meter to AC voltage. Measure between the hot (short slot) and neutral (long slot). Capture the reading; it should be near 120 V.

steps.title: Measure Hot-Ground
steps.instruction: Measure between the hot (short slot) and ground (round pin). Capture the reading; it should closely match the hot-neutral value on a correctly wired receptacle.

acceptance.description: Hot-ground should be within 3% of hot-neutral; a large gap suggests an open or high-resistance ground.

steps.title: Measure Neutral-Ground
steps.instruction: Measure between neutral (long slot) and ground (round pin). Capture the reading; on a healthy circuit this offset is small (typically under ~2 V under load).

acceptance.description: Neutral-ground offset should stay low; high values indicate an overloaded neutral or bootleg/open ground.

steps.title: Record Result
steps.instruction: Document the survey. Abnormal readings can indicate reversed polarity, open ground, open neutral, or a bootleg ground.
steps.note_prompt: Summarize wiring condition and any defects found.
